en.hubeali: H 14896 – Ismail Bin Abdullah Al-Qarshy who said:

A man came up to Abu Abdullahasws, so he said to himasws, ‘O sonasws of the Messengerasws of Allahazwj, I saw in my dream as if I was outside of the city of Al-Kufa in a place which I recognised, and there was a ghost of a man made of wood, riding a wooden horse and waving his sword, and I saw him and was terrified and in a panic’. So heasws said to him: ‘You are a man who wants to assassinate a man for his livelihood, so fear Allahazwj Who Created you, then will Cause you to die’.

So the man said, ‘I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> have received Knowledge and have extracted it from its mine. I inform you<sup>asws</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> that you<sup>asws</sup> have interpreted (correctly) for me. There was a man in my neighbourhood who came to me and presented to me his asset, so I thought that I should own it for much less as I realised that there is no other seeker for it apart from me’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And your companion has befriended us<sup>asws</sup> rather our<sup>asws</sup> enemies?’ He said, ‘Yes, O son<sup>asws</sup> of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, a good man with foresight, resolute in the Religion, and I repent to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to you<sup>asws</sup> from what I was thinking of and intended for. So, inform me, O son<sup>asws</sup> of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, had he been a Hostile One (Nasibi), would it have been permissible for me to assassinate him?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Fulfil the trust to the one who has entrusted you and wants advice from you even if it is to the killer of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 449. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al-Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazaalat Bin Ayyub, from Sayf Bin Umeyr, from Abu Bakr Al-Hazramy, from Abdul Malik Bin Ayn who said:

I got up in the presence of Abu Ja’far (a.s.), supporting myself by my hands, so I wept’. He (a.s.) said: ‘What is the matter with you?’ So I said, ‘I used to hope that I would see this Command (Al-Qaim (a.s.)) whilst having strength’. So he (a.s.) said: ‘But are you not happy that your enemies kill each other and you are safe in your houses?’

If that event were to take place, the man from among you would be given the strength of forty men and your hearts would become like blocks of iron. If thrown against the mountain, it would be uprooted. You are the strength of the earth and its treasures’.
